verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe confirms a downloadable OpenAPI document at learning.postman.com/openapi.json (HTTP 200, contains an "openapi" key), and Postman documents a programmatic Postman API for managing assets. Together these give an AI-native user a machine-readable spec to fetch. missing for 10: confirmation that the openapi.json actually describes the full Postman API surface (vs. a docs-site artifact), first-party documentation pointing users to the spec download, independent corroboration of its completeness
